regime_context: The detector shows Cybersecurity as the dominant trend with full breadth and high durability, but it is crowded. Momentum rank is only a focus lens, not a return forecast. The absolute-trend gate (validated risk control) is active, meaning trend-following discipline reduces drawdowns. Given the 40% hit rate and 25% directional accuracy in the track record, all thematic leans are held with low conviction.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity (CIBR) is the confirmed thematic leader with strong trend durability (0.9) and perfect breadth (1.0), suggesting institutional commitment. Crowding flags (z=2.13) indicate the rally is extended, so this is a trend-following overweight that should be sized down as per risk control, not faded.
theses.dissent: High crowding and a macro shock (e.g., AI-driven obsolescence fears) could trigger a sharp mean-reversion in perceived 'safe-haven' tech.

falsifier.text: CIBR closes below its 50-day exponential moving average and breadth drops below 0.7.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners (SIL) display a robust, broad uptrend with high durability (0.76) and no crowding, supported by full component participation. This suggests a non-exhausted trend phase suitable for trend-following allocation.
theses.dissent: A strong dollar or risk-off move could crush silver prices and miners, given their cyclical exposure.

falsifier.text: SIL underperforms the S&P 500 by more than 5% over any rolling 10-day period or its 50-day moving average turns decisively lower.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners (GDX) have high durability (0.82), full breadth, no crowding, and trend classification. This offers a potential safe-haven play if macro uncertainty persists, though momentum is not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Gold miners are capital-intensive; if real rates rise, gold may weaken and miners could underperform even a flat gold price.

falsifier.text: GDX fails to hold its 50-day moving average for more than 3 consecutive days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
